description: This Java class 'JNDIContextFactory' provides a centralized way to obtain and cache JNDI InitialContext instances based on server configuration. It manages a cache of contexts, retrieves configuration details, and handles context creation with proper error handling.

classes.name: JNDIContextFactory
classes.description: Provides static methods to retrieve and manage JNDI InitialContext instances based on server configuration, with caching and error handling.

methods.name: getInitialContext
methods.description: Returns the JNDI InitialContext for a given server name, creating and caching it if necessary, with configuration and error handling.

methods.name: clearInitialContext
methods.description: Removes the cached InitialContext for a specified server name from the cache.
